caseNameFull: Ex parte Raymond Oswald De Maurez
attorneys: Raymond Oswald De-Maurez, pro se. Assistant Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Berge, and Mr. Oscar A. Provost for P. J. Squier, Warden, respondent.

opinions.text: The motion for leave to file petition for writ of certiorari is granted. The motion for leave to proceed further in forma pauperis, and the petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, are denied.
